functions.note: This uses the UN way of counting defence. NATO targets count it a different way, so the two do not match. NATO includes pay-outs to retired forces staff. Here those are under pensions and benefits. (PESA Table 4.2, note 1)

functions.plain: Police, courts, prisons and fire services

functions.note: Network Rail is only counted from 2015-16. From 2008-09 the figures include help for banks. From 2020-21 they include help during Covid and when prices rose fast. (PESA Table 4.2, notes 2 and 3)
From 2011-12 the cost of student loans is not counted here. So you cannot fairly compare years before and after 2011-12. (PESA Table 4.2, note 5)
